The waypoints below are the commands executed in the live episode. Each row is

from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
from rcb_client import Robot


OUT = Path('/app/output/replay_record')

# count, arm translation in base frame, grip, base velocity, hybrid mode, note
SEGMENTS = [
    (5, (0.20, -0.20, 0), -1, (0, 0, 0), -1, 'probe'),
    (30, (0.50, -0.50, 0), -1, (0, 0, 0), -1, 'approach'),
    (30, (0.10, -0.12, -0.50), -1, (0, 0, 0), -1, 'lower_above_steak'),
    (15, (0, -0.15, 0), -1, (0, 0, 0), -1, 'align_steak'),
    (12, (0, -0.05, -0.30), -1, (0, 0, 0), -1, 'descend_grasp'),
    (20, (0, 0, 0), 1, (0, 0, 0), -1, 'first_grasp'),
    (20, (0, 0, 0.35), 1, (0, 0, 0), -1, 'first_lift_test'),
    (20, (0.08, -0.09, -0.55), -1, (0, 0, 0), -1, 'reapproach'),
    (20, (0, 0, 0), 1, (0, 0, 0), -1, 'grasp'),
    (20, (0, 0, 0.40), 1, (0, 0, 0), -1, 'lift'),
    (22, (0, 0, 0.40), 1, (0, 0, 0), -1, 'clear_stove'),
    (20, (0, 0, 0), 1, (0, 0.40, 0), 1, 'base_side_trial'),
    (60, (0, 0, 0), 1, (0, 0.50, 0), 1, 'base_to_plate'),
    (30, (-0.12, 0.40, 0), 1, (0, 0, 0), -1, 'align_plate_xy'),
    (15, (-0.12, 0.12, 0), 1, (0, 0, 0), -1, 'fine_plate_xy'),

    (30, (0, 0, 0), -1, (0, 0, 0), -1, 'release_on_plate'),
    (45, (0, 0, 0.50), -1, (0, 0, 0), -1, 'retreat'),
]


def main():
    robot = Robot()
    if robot.status()['control_steps']:
        raise RuntimeError('Episode already in progress; preserve its final state')
    cameras = list(robot.spec()['cameras'])
    OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

        row[:3] = arm

        row[7:10] = base
        row[11] = mode
        result = robot.submit(

            cameras=cameras, include_depth=True, video='none', note=note,

        result.save(OUT / f"{result.meta['control_steps']:04d}_{note}")
